enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the fan running for air circulation
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Close eyes. Remain lying on the bed asleep. Turn over on the bed. Pull the blanket. Fan runs continuously, blowing air across the room. Remain lying on the bed asleep until 06:30.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, using the toilet and washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up on the bed. Swing legs off the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Walk to the toilet. Lift the toilet lid. Sit on the toilet. Use the toilet. Stand up. Press the flush button. Walk to the sink. Turn on the tap. Bend over the sink. Cup hands and splash water on the face. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face. Pick up the toothbrush. Turn on the tap and wet the toothbrush. Put toothpaste on the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Spit into the sink. Turn off the tap. Put the toothbrush back. Wipe hands with the towel. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle and toasting bread
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out bread, milk and eggs. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Pick up the kettle. Fill the kettle with water at the tap. Put the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch to start boiling. Open the cabinet. Take out a plate. Put the plate on the counter. Open the bread bag. Take out two slices of bread. Put the slices into the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Open the refrigerator door. Take out butter. Close the refrigerator door. Pick up a knife. Spread butter on the toast when it pops up. Open the microwave door. Put a bowl inside. Close the microwave door. Press the start button. When the kettle boils, pick it up and pour hot water into a cup. Put the kettle back. Take the bowl out of the microwave. Sit down at the table. Eat the toast and eggs. Drink the hot water. Stand up. Carry the plate and cup to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing a bag for the workday
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Bedroom 1. Open the wardrobe door. Take out a shirt. Take out trousers. Take out socks. Close the wardrobe door. Take off sleepwear. Put on the shirt. Put on the trousers. Put on the socks. Pull on shoes. Pick up the bag. Open the bag. Put the wallet into the bag. Put the phone into the bag. Put the keys into the bag. Put the notebook into the bag. Close the bag. Hang the bag on the shoulder. Walk to the door. Pick up the jacket. Put on the jacket. Open the door. Walk out of Bedroom 1.

Walk out of the apartment building. Pull the phone out of the bag. Look at the phone screen. Put the phone back in the bag. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take out the phone. Look at the phone. Board the bus. Tap the card on the card reader. Walk down the aisle. Hold the handrail. Stand or sit on the bus. Press the stop button. Get off the bus. Walk along the sidewalk. Walk through the office building entrance. Press the elevator call button. Step into the elevator. Press the floor button. Step out of the elevator. Walk to the office desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, coordinating community programs and answering emails and calls
enriched_activities.desc: Sit down at the office desk. Press the computer power button. Open the email application. Read emails. Type replies on the keyboard. Click the send button. Pick up the desk phone. Dial a phone number. Talk on the phone about the community program schedule. Hang up the phone. Pick up the phone handset again. Dial the partner organization. Talk about the program dates. Hang up. Open the document file on the computer. Type the program outline. Move the mouse and click. Print the outline. Stand up. Walk to the printer. Pick up the printed pages. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Pick up the stapler. Staple the pages. Put the pages in a folder. Stand up. Walk to a colleague's desk. Hand over the folder. Talk with the colleague about the event sign-up list. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Open the calendar on the computer. Type the meeting times.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the desk. Push the chair in. Walk out of the office. Walk along the street. Push open the restaurant door. Walk to the counter. Read the menu board. Order a lunch set. Pay with the phone at the scanner. Take the receipt. Walk to a table. Pull out the chair. Sit down. Open the chopstick wrapper. Pick up the chopsticks. Eat the lunch. Pick up the cup. Drink water. Put down the chopsticks. Stand up. Push the chair in. Walk to the door. Push open the door. Walk back to the office building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, running program planning and partner meetings
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the desk. Sit down. Press the computer power button. Open the meeting file. Stand up. Pick up the notebook. Walk to the meeting room. Open the meeting room door. Turn on the meeting room light. Sit down at the table. Open the notebook. Pick up the pen. Write down the agenda items. Stand up. Write on the whiteboard with a marker. Point at the whiteboard. Sit down. Talk about the program timeline with the partners. Take notes on the notebook. Nod and write. Stand up. Shake hands with the partner. Walk to the door. Open the door. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Pick up the desk phone. Call the venue contact. Confirm the booking date. Hang up. Type the meeting minutes on the computer. Press the save button.

Stand up from the desk. Press the computer power button to shut down. Pick up the bag. Walk out of the office. Press the elevator call button. Step into the elevator. Press the ground floor button. Step out of the elevator. Walk out of the building. Walk to the bus stop. Stand and wait. Board the bus. Tap the card on the card reader. Hold the handrail. Press the stop button. Get off the bus. Walk along the sidewalk. Walk to the apartment building. Open the building door. Walk up the stairs or take the elevator. Open the apartment door. Walk in.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and eating at home
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Turn on the range hood. Open the refrigerator door. Take out vegetables, meat and eggs. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Open the cabinet. Take out a cutting board. Put the cutting board on the counter. Pick up a knife. Cut the vegetables. Cut the meat. Put the knife down. Pick up the pot. Fill the pot with water at the tap. Put the pot on the induction cooker. Press the induction cooker power button. Press the power level button. Wait for the water to boil. Pick up the vegetables. Put the vegetables into the pot. Pick up the spatula. Stir the food. Pick up the salt box. Sprinkle salt into the pot. Press the induction cooker button to lower the power. Pick up a bowl. Scoop the food into the bowl. Pick up a bowl and chopsticks. Walk to the table. Sit down. Eat the meal. Pick up the cup. Drink water. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and loading the dishwasher, tidying the kitchen counters
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the bowls and plates. Carry them to the sink. Turn on the tap. Pick up the sponge. Squeeze dish soap onto the sponge. Scrub the plates with the sponge. Scrub the bowls. Scrub the chopsticks. Rinse the plates under the tap. Open the dishwasher door. Pull out the bottom rack. Load the plates into the rack. Load the bowls into the rack. Put the chopsticks in the basket. Push the rack in. Close the dishwasher door. Press the dishwasher start button. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the counter with the cloth. Turn off the tap. Wipe the stove surface with the cloth. Put the cloth on the hook. Turn off the range hood. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa, checking the phone and planning the next day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the sofa. Sit down on the sofa. Lean back on the sofa. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Press the phone power button. Unlock the phone screen. Swipe up and down on the screen. Tap on the calendar app. Type next day's schedule entries. Tap the save button. Tap on the notes app. Type a shopping list. Put the phone down on the sofa cushion. Pick up the phone again. Check messages. Put the phone down on the side table. Stand up from the sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a hot shower (after the 8pm peak window to avoid the water-heater tax)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Open the shower curtain. Turn on the water heater switch. Turn on the shower tap. Adjust the water temperature handle. Step under the water. Wet the hair. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Pour shampoo into the hand. Rub the hair. Rinse the hair under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap on the body. Rinse the body under the water. Turn off the shower tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the hair with the towel. Wipe the body with the towel. Turn on the bathroom fan. Turn off the water heater switch. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and unwinding with light leisure
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the sofa. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the TV remote control. Press the TV power button. Press the channel button. Point the remote at the TV. Press the volume button. Put the remote down on the sofa cushion. Watch the TV. Pick up the phone. Unlock the phone screen. Tap on a video app. Scroll through the video list. Play a video. Put the phone down on the side table. Pick up the remote control. Press the channel button. Stand up from the sofa. Walk to the refrigerator in the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out a bottle of water. Close the refrigerator door. Walk back to the sofa. Sit down. Open the bottle cap. Drink water. Close the bottle cap. Put the bottle on the side table. Pick up the remote control. Press the TV power button to turn off the TV. Stand up from the sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine: washing up, setting out clothes and reading a little
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Cup hands and splash water on the face. Pick up the toothbrush. Put toothpaste on the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit into the sink. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk to Bedroom 1. Open the wardrobe door. Take out a shirt. Lay the shirt on the chair. Take out trousers. Lay the trousers on the chair. Close the wardrobe door. Pick up the book on the nightstand. Sit on the bed. Open the book. Read several pages. Close the book. Put the book on the nightstand. Turn on the fan. Turn off the bedroom light.
Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Close eyes. Turn over on the bed. Remain lying on the bed asleep. Fan runs continuously. Remain lying on the bed asleep until 24:00.
